name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Conjuration goes with Bard or Orin goes with Necromancy.
Lyra goes with exactly one of Ranger, Illusion, or Raven.
If Abjuration goes with Wrenna, then Orin goes with Hawk.
Ranger goes with exactly two of Wrenna, Abjuration, and Owl.
Exactly one of these is true: Bard goes with Necromancy; Cleric goes with Hawk; Ranger goes with Raven.
Fenwick, Lyra, and Orin go with Illusion, Hawk, and Owl, in some order.
Toad goes with at most one of Lyra, Paladin, and Conjuration.
Between Fenwick and Lyra, one goes with Illusion and the other with Necromancy.

hints.text: Suppose Fenwick went with Abjuration — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Fenwick goes with Abjuration.
Fenwick goes with Abjuration, so it can't also go with Illusion.
Fenwick goes with Abjuration, so it can't also go with Necromancy.
…but now the clue “Between Fenwick and Lyra, one goes with Illusion and the other with Necromancy” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Fenwick does not go with Abjuration.
